facts.statement: On November 4, 2012, SOE offered Triple Station Cash for one day on Station Cash purchases made in-game, online, or by redeeming an SOE pre-paid game card.
facts.quote: On November 4th, 2012 SOE is treating you to Triple Station Cash!

facts.statement: The Triple Station Cash offer ran from 12:01 AM PDT on 11/4/12 to 11:59 PM PST on 11/4/12.
facts.quote: Offer is valid between 12:01 AM PDT 11/4/12 and 11:59 PM PST 11/4/12.

article_summaries.title: Triple Station Cash for Halloween
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official freerealms.com news post announcing a one-day Triple Station Cash promotion on November 4, 2012, covering in-game, online and pre-paid card purchases of Station Cash. The post itself is listed as posted '3 weeks, 6 days ago' relative to the capture, so its exact posting date is not stated. Purchases made by SMS payment were excluded.
